metadata.title: Simple Slice Surfaces
metadata.abstract: Given a simply-connected $4$-manifold with boundary the $3$-sphere, we give sufficient conditions for a knot in the boundary to bound a simply embedded locally flat surface in the $4$-manifold of fixed nonzero genus, representing a fixed nonzero homology class. In certain indefinite cases, we also give conditions for these slice surfaces to be unique up to equivalence.
